summary: Candidate 08c66ccee87802d8fcbd123d18e0ec9115cab634 fixes and validates the ROCm JIT runtime's HIP-SDK build/link dependency, but only a subset of the original RFC: backend autodetection and the proposed rocdl;nvvm dual-backend wheel remain unimplemented.

tests.what_was_measured: Prepared base reproduction: configure failed because required HIP package discovery could not be disabled.
Candidate native C++ rebuild with pinned LLVM plus one-GPU vector-add smoke on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950.

tests.command: cmake configure with CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_hip=TRUE, then cmake --build ... --target FlyJitRuntime -j2
tests.what_was_measured: Candidate runtime configured and built without HIP package discovery.
Uncached GPU pointer vector-add versus PyTorch reference at unchanged 1e-5 tolerance; 1 passed; emitted gfx950 ISA showed global loads, v_add_f32_e32, and global store.

tests.command: ctypes lazy-load and adversarial HIP wrapper boundary script
tests.what_was_measured: No libamdhip64 mapping after loading the candidate library; exact odd-count memset32/memset16 results, one-byte allocation/free, and event/stream lifecycle all passed.

tests.command: readelf -d and nm -D --undefined-only on candidate libfly_jit_runtime.so
tests.what_was_measured: No libamdhip64 DT_NEEDED entry and no undefined HIP symbols.

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) ran the required native smoke, the independent pointer vector-add reference check, and adversarial device-memory/event/stream checks. ISA target was amdgcn-amd-amdhsa-unknown-gfx950.
remaining_limitations: ROCm 7.2 was installed on the host, so a physically SDK-free host and a complete built wheel were not tested. Only gfx950 AMD hardware was available. CUDA/NVVM, NVIDIA hardware, dual-backend packaging, backend autodetection, and cluster-launch behavior remain unverified or unimplemented.
